flags.detail: FINDINGS.md and arc_verdict.json both claim the height-308 bundle witness is now 'SAGE-verified on-bench' / 'no longer single-homed' / 'dual-homed', but the committed reproduce.sh script that is supposed to demonstrate this only opens and prints the static witness_sage.txt file and asserts two literal substrings are present in it — it never invokes Sage or recomputes any cohomology. A stranger cannot reproduce the claimed Sage verification from the committed files; witness_sage.txt could have been hand-written or copied from codex's off-branch output without this bench ever running Sage.
test_reproduce_runner_committed_and_reproduces only checks the committed reproduce*.sh/output .txt contains the literal string 'REPRODUCES', not a live re-run
